maps.name: TAB BR - Moorland
maps.about: TAB's generator, its first landscape: forests, meadows and dirt, a few lakes and rocks - the zombies get stronger further out

maps.name: TAB TM - Lowlands
maps.about: TAB's generator: wide green land for farms, hardly any mountains, the strong zombies far out - wide fronts

maps.name: TAB AL - Highlands
maps.about: TAB's generator: mountains and lakes leave little room - more villages, closer and bigger

maps.name: TAB DS - Wasteland
maps.about: TAB's generator: dry dirt, little forest and grass, many rocks - few walls of forest to hide behind

maps.name: TAB FA - Caustic
maps.about: TAB's generator: swamp - water and forest everywhere, in small pieces, lots of zombies

maps.name: TAB VO - Volcanic
maps.about: TAB's generator: rock everywhere, narrow ways, the strongest zombies close - the hardest

maps.name: Peaceful Lowlands
maps.about: Wide dry plains, green meadows with groves, big lakes - lots of room for farms, but wide fronts to hold

maps.name: Green Valley
maps.about: Lakes, ridges, forests and rivers - the ways in are easy to read

maps.name: Broken Lands
maps.about: Regions walled off by rock and forest - hold the passes. Two huge villages of doom

maps.name: Old Fortress
maps.about: Rings of rock around the base - the openings never line up

maps.name: Red Canyons
maps.about: Winding canyons through solid rock - long ways, little room to build

maps.name: Open Plains
maps.about: Grass and lone trees - nothing walls you in, nothing walls them out. Many small villages
